title: Add a release entry
prompt: Add a 1.4.0 entry at the top of the changelog (below the title) with the line "- Added export to CSV". Then run `python3 tests/check_task.py` and save its output to out/check.log. It must print PASS.

files.tests/check_task.py:
s=open('CHANGELOG.md').read(); ok=s.find('## 1.4.0')>=0 and s.find('## 1.4.0')<s.find('## 1.3.2') and '- Added export to CSV' in s
print('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL')
